name: delivery-docket
title: Delivery docket
for_each: select delivery_id as id, (ref || ' ' || customer) as name from v_deliveries where delivered_on > current_date - 14 order by delivered_on desc

sections.title: Delivery
sections.sql: select d.ref as delivery, d.docket_no as docket, to_char(d.delivered_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as date, d.customer, d.site, d.tank_no as tank, p.name as product, p.un_number as un_number, case when p.dg_class is null then 'not dangerous goods' else 'Class ' || p.dg_class end as dangerous_goods_class, d.litres as litres_delivered, d.before_litres as tank_before, d.after_litres as tank_after, d.run_ref as run, d.rego as tanker, d.driver, tr.meter_ref as meter, coalesce(d.signed_by, '') as received_by from v_deliveries d join deliveries dv on dv.id = d.delivery_id join products p on p.id = dv.product_id left join runs r on r.id = dv.run_id left join trucks tr on tr.id = r.truck_id where d.delivery_id = $1

sections.title: Price
sections.note: Terminal gate price on the day plus the agreed margin, cents a litre, before GST.
sections.sql: select d.price_cpl as cents_a_litre_ex_gst, d.value_ex_gst as value_ex_gst, round(d.value_ex_gst * (select value::numeric from settings where key = 'gst_rate'), 2) as gst, round(d.value_ex_gst * (1 + (select value::numeric from settings where key = 'gst_rate')), 2) as total_incl_gst from v_deliveries d where d.delivery_id = $1

name: customer-statement
title: Statement of account
for_each: select customer_id as id, customer as name from v_debtors where owed_ex_gst > 0 order by customer

sections.title: Account
sections.sql: select c.name as customer, c.code as account, c.contact_name as attention, to_char(current_date, 'DD Month YYYY') as statement_date, c.terms_days || ' days' as terms, d.owed_ex_gst as balance_ex_gst, round(d.owed_ex_gst * (1 + (select value::numeric from settings where key = 'gst_rate')), 2) as balance_incl_gst, d.overdue_ex_gst as overdue_ex_gst from customers c join v_debtors d on d.customer_id = c.id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Unpaid deliveries
sections.sql: select to_char(delivered_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, coalesce(invoice_no, ref) as invoice, docket_no as docket, site, product, litres, price_cpl as cents_a_litre, value_ex_gst, to_char(due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as due, case when due_on < current_date then (current_date - due_on) || ' days overdue' else '' end as status from v_deliveries where customer_id = $1 and paid_on is null order by delivered_on

name: run-sheet
title: Driver run sheet
for_each: select id, (ref || ' ' || to_char(run_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) as name from runs where run_on >= current_date and status in ('planned', 'loaded') order by run_on

sections.title: The run
sections.sql: select r.ref as run, to_char(r.run_on, 'Day DD Month YYYY') as date, tr.rego as tanker, d.name as driver, to_char(d.dg_endorsement_expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as dg_endorsement_to, tm.name as lift_at from runs r join trucks tr on tr.id = r.truck_id join drivers d on d.id = r.driver_id join terminals tm on tm.id = r.terminal_id where r.id = $1

sections.title: Lift at the terminal
sections.sql: select p.code as product, p.un_number, sum(o.planned_litres) as litres from orders o join tanks t on t.id = o.tank_id join products p on p.id = t.product_id where o.run_id = $1 and o.status = 'planned' group by p.code, p.un_number order by p.code

sections.title: Drops
sections.sql: select o.ref as order_ref, c.name as customer, s.name as site, s.address, t.tank_no as tank, p.code as product, o.planned_litres as litres, floor(t.capacity_l * t.safe_fill_pct / 100.0)::int as safe_fill, coalesce(s.access_notes, '') as access, coalesce(o.po_number, '') as po from orders o join tanks t on t.id = o.tank_id join sites s on s.id = t.site_id join customers c on c.id = s.customer_id join products p on p.id = t.product_id where o.run_id = $1 and o.status = 'planned' order by o.ref
